details: idea tensix_transpose: move nhwc_rm_transpose [w,c]->[c,w] onto Tensix
riscv_transpose idea: faster RISC-V transpose + more RISCs on nhwc_rm_transpose p44
rm_issue_cost: reader/writer issue cost + fill for nhwc_rm_transpose p44

Read reader/writer/plan. Levers: (1) reader cursor raw issue (bank cursor + firmware bank tables, len set once) in page-order path only; (2) writer cursor raw issue stepping by H pages; (3) fill: BLOCK_PAGES=64 (1-unit blocks) and/or ramp; DRAM bank-major + FLUX coalesced untouched by construction. Harness: monkeypatch nhwc.create_program_descriptor, my kernel copies with ABL_NO_GATHER, 12 launches, median 2..12.

pipeline: reader lands each page in a Ct*64B slot (32 slots = one w-tile RM block), compute tilize->transpose->pack_untilize_dest<kw> gives 32 rows of kw*32 values per c-tile, writer writes partial rows. Variants: two_pass (tilize to CB tiles, transpose_tile+pack_untilize), fused (unpack_tilize+datacopy+transpose_dest+pack_untilize). Formats: bf16 vs uint16. Bit-exact probe first.

Read regime/writer/reader/transpose. Plan: microbench per-RISC transpose impls (baseline pb1, pb8, line-batched word pairs, lw+2sh halfword stores) on DM and TRISC, contention scaling; then full-op variants: DM opt, dm2 split, TRISC transposers synced via CB stream counters (tiles_received regs reset per launch).

p44 L1 median of 11: base full 59244 / nogather 13491; rcur 56431/10669; wcur 58304/11627; rwcur 55515/8778. all bit-exact. reader issue 12.0k->7.25k cyc (37.5->22.7 cyc/page). Loop is 18 instr incl MMIO poll.

all 65536 bf16 patterns, L1 [1,2,1024,32]: two_pass/uint16 BIT-EXACT; two_pass/bf16 NOT (denormals->0, NaN payload->0xff80, -0->+0: 509 mismatches); fused variants wrong layout: BH unpack_tilize (16-bit) copies L1 linearly into srcA, the reorder happens in the packer (PackMode::Tilize), so tilize->transpose_dest->untilize in one pass needs a math-side row gather

cycles/unit(2048 vals): BRISC base1 12333 (matches op), base8 7741, line8 7840, half(sh) 12.6k; O3==O2. TRISC1 base1 10279 line4 8323. Contention: B+N each 2x slower; T1+T2 each 2x; BN012 line4: B/N/T0 18.6k, T1/T2 12.5k -> aggregate ~3.1k cyc/unit; looks like 2 shared L1 store groups at ~5-6 cyc/store. Next: probe strides (bank conflicts?) and pure store/load kernels.
p44 L1: baseline 59244 ns, stock 17147 ns, two_pass/uint16 (kw=2, 110 cores) 12947 ns, bit-exact. All 18 regime shapes bit-exact incl. all-65536-pattern fills.

r2 had profiler DRAM overflow on last combo (unit_trid nogather invalid); added ReadDeviceProfiler per combo. r3 p44 L1: rwcur_bp64 51892/8499, rw2 55901/8506, rw2_bp64 51704/7963, rw2_unit 51797/7996, rw2_unit_trid 52310/7130, rw2_unit_trid1 51584/7299 (best full). 2buf read 18.5 cyc/page. Next: make reader fallbacks robust for DRAM/FLUX, domain tests.

Probes: seq word stores 2.2 cyc/store, no contention across 5 RISCs; scattered/partial-line stores 5.5 cyc and contend within groups {B,N,T0} and {T1,T2}. GCC scattered the store order (and uses xttzbkb pack). Volatile-ordered BLK 16 pages x 1 word (2 rows x 8 consecutive words): BRISC 5269 cyc/unit (2.34x vs 12333); 5 RISCs concurrently: aggregate 1357 cyc/unit (9.1x). Next: full-op pipeline with TRISC transposers (row-range split), sync via CB tiles_received stream regs.
nhwc suite 21/21 pass for rw2_unit_trid1, rw2_unit_trid, rw2_bp64, rwcur_bp64 (after making cursor static_assert dependent); FLUX suite 46/46 pass with RC+R2 reader.

single-row MOVA2D gather did not move single rows on BH (wrong). New fused_d2b: unpack_tilize (row-linear srcA) -> 8 MOVA2D into scratch DEST tile -> per 16x16 block 16 single-row MOVD2B gather + TRNSPSRCB + 4 MOVB2D into transposed face -> pack_untilize_dest. Position probe: exact transpose.

L1: rw2_unit_trid1 51587/7384 (repro); rw2_unit_trid1_bp64 52283/7421 (ring 2 starves trid); rw2_unit_bp64 51629/7996; coalesced+compact on nhwc L1 = 96953/60007 (compact 211 cyc/page for 64B pages) -> regression.

p44 L1 bit-exact all; median of 11 (ns): op 59240, solo_base1 59245 (faithful copy), solo_base8 48315, solo_blkv16 34610, tri_b4_r1 21998, tri_b4_r2 20213, tri_b1_d4_r2 14612, tri_b1_d4_r3 14638, tri_b2_d3_r2 15138, quad(B share) 15784. TRISC transposers + 1-unit blocks beat stock 17139.

DRAM p44: base 87399/43810, rwcur_bp64 65275/41311, rw2_unit_bp64 65142/41345, rw2_unit_trid1(ring8) 76760/41313, coal_w_b32 76024/32284. Defined best = rw2_unit_trid1 kernels + BLOCK_PAGES {L1:256, DRAM:64}; exact on 8 sweep shapes + nhwc suite 21/21.
S1 read split (BRISC reads last 1/4 of each unit on NOC1, NCRISC rest): p44 L1 12425 ns (tri 14627, op 59247); 5/16: 12506, 3/8: 12910, d6: 12450. Bit-exact.

best (L1 page cursor+unit/trid; DRAM coalesced bp64 b32): p44 L1 59249->51587 / stub 13507->7379; p44 DRAM 87135->60793 / 43876->29514; h256 DRAM 163907->109532 / 99121->61168; c64 DRAM 59261->52270 full but stub 28810->39317 (compaction of 128B pages).

Streamed per-item writes WORSE (s1q_st 13521 vs s1q 12438): BRISC tail longer, read barrier late. Block-0 half split no gain (12459). Steady state now balanced ~2.1-2.3k cyc/unit on all 5 RISCs; remaining = fill+drain. Next: correctness+perf domain sweep (DRAM, odd C, tails) for op/solo_blkv16/tri/s1q.

p44 L1: tpt(two_pass+trid) 11687/11690, fdt(fused_d2b+trid) 11613/11612 (FLAT -0.66%). c128 kw4: tpt 14544, fdt 14272 (FLAT). Compute-only ablation (no reads/writes): p44 tpt 3410 vs fdt 1907; c128 tpt 5093 vs fdt 4073. Recommend fdt; starting domain sweep baseline vs fdt.

All 12 cases bit-exact (random bits) for op/solo_blkv16/tri/s1q. ns op->tri->s1q: p44_l1 59247/14622/12433, p44_dram 87093/43081/52549 (S1 hurts DRAM), c64 18140/7154/6807, c3 5558/4149/3636, c5_dram 3256/2744/2837, c1 2639/2530/2324, w1000 9807/5281/4650, w5_dram 2241/1501/1490, n2 27038/9459/8917, tails faster too. Next: DRAM block-size sweep for tri.

DM-only split duo (NCRISC+BRISC transpose, no TRISC): b1 25176 / n3b5 24495 / b4 32496 ns; penta (all 5) 17422; T+N 17873; T+B (quad) 16016; s1q 12614 (same run). TRISC-only transpose + DM read split is fastest. DRAM p44: tri b1 43.3us best (b2 44.9, b4 49.8); S1 52.5 on DRAM.

verdict WIN. best: p44 L1 59249->51587 (stub 13507->7379); p44 DRAM 87135->60793 (stub 43876->29514); L1 sweep 1.41-1.88x; DRAM h256 1.50x, c64 (page-wise rule) 1.66x. Coalesced restricted to DRAM pages<=64B (c64 DRAM coalesced stub +10us). nhwc suite 21/21, FLUX suite 46/46. Device CSVs deleted, zones saved to logs/zones_best_vs_base.txt.

Verdict WIN. Best p44 L1: s1q (TRISC0/1/2 transpose 6/5/5 row items, NCRISC reads 3/4, BRISC reads 1/4 + writes, 1-unit blocks, depth 4, 2 rows gens) 12.4-12.6us vs op 59.2us, stock 17.1us; tri (no read split) 14.6us. DRAM p44: tri 43.1us vs op 87.1us (S1 regresses on DRAM: 52.5). O3 flat. DM-only splits 24.5-32.5us. Final sweep 72/72 bit-exact. Shared header untouched (FLUX unaffected). Files left uncommitted in perf_experiments/riscv_transpose and tests/.../perf1/riscv_transpose.

verdict WIN. rec = fused_d2b/uint16 + own trid reader (L1) / op shared reader (DRAM). p44 L1 59244->11613 ns; p44 DRAM 87164->41862; sweep all wins (1.37x-8.4x) incl. tiny DRAM after sub-tile units (2300->2198). two_pass+trid 11690 (flat vs fused end-to-end; compute-only 3410 vs 1907). Float16_b CB not bit-exact; UInt16 bit-exact on all 65536 patterns. All 18 regime shapes + forced tails bit-exact.
